name: Omarchy Browser
summary: The web browser with the Omarchy Store built in
description:
What's new: the first browser made for Omarchy, with the Omarchy Store one click away.

Omarchy Browser is a fast Chromium-based web browser with the Omarchy Store built right in. Browse the web in tabs, and whenever you want a new app, press Store and it's there in a side panel next to your page.

THE STORE, RIGHT NEXT TO YOUR PAGE
• Press Store (or Ctrl+B) to open the Omarchy Store in a side panel
• Featured apps, browsers and top picks on the front page, plus every category
• Search any app and press GET to install it
• Open any app's full store page in a new tab with one click

A REAL CHROMIUM BROWSER
• Tabs, address bar, back, forward and reload
• Type an address or just search: results come from DuckDuckGo
• Links that open new windows open as new tabs instead
• Stays signed in to your sites between launches

SAFE INSTALLS
• GET uses Omarchy's own installer, in a terminal you can see
• You type your own password: the browser never sees it
• It only installs apps listed in the Omarchy Store

MADE FOR OMARCHY
• Dark look that fits right in on Omarchy
• Tiny download: it uses the Chromium engine that's already on your computer
• Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+T new tab, Ctrl+W close tab, Ctrl+L address bar, Ctrl+B store, Ctrl+Tab next tab, Alt+Left/Right back and forward

Free and open source (MIT), from Omarchy Development Labs.

steps.title: Press GET
steps.body: The store downloads Omarchy Browser, checks it's genuine and installs it. You confirm with your password.

steps.title: Open Omarchy Browser

steps.title: Press Store
steps.body: The Omarchy Store opens next to your page. Find an app, press GET, done.
